scope: Theorem 6.1 (Vey) of the manuscript “Symmetry of semialgebraic bounded domains with compact quotient” (preprints/Symmetry-of-semialgebraic-bounded-domains-with-compact-quotient-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 058 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a93c6ca7f3221b45), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let D ⊂ Cm × Ck be a connected domain biholomorphic to a bounded domain. Suppose that D contains a point (0, w) and is invariant under (z, w) 7−→ (z, w + a), (z, w) 7−→ (eiθ z, w), (z, w) 7−→ (r1/2 z, rw) for every a ∈ Rk, θ ∈ R, and r > 0. If D is divisible, it is biholomorphic to a bounded symmetric domain. The case m = 0 is included.
